title: Silver Rewards Card: Making Payments and Managing Your Account
summary: This document explains Silver Rewards Card monthly payments and interest: minimum payment is 1.5% of statement balance (plus a statement-based minimum) and late fees are $32.50, with standard carried-balance APR at 18.99%. It also covers no annual fee ($0.00), credit limit range ($10,000–$100,000), foreign transaction fees (2.75% without premium vs 0% with premium), rewards redemption starting at 17 available, and purchase protection (90 days; up to $3,000 per claim).
